title: Dazed Florida Woman’s Morning at McDonald’s Ends Without a Happy Meal
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida deputies confronting a woman accused of nodding off in traffic and hitting another vehicle on July 10. Leesburg police said Courtney Moore allegedly caused over $1500 in damages to the driver’s truck. The 30-year-old Florida woman was pulled over outside a McDonald’s before officers asked her to perform sobriety tests. Moore, struggling to keep her eyes open, obliged and told police she had “been up all night.” She was arrested and charged with careless driving and DUI. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
